situation (example wording): "What share of Florida is covered by NIBRS?"
what the app does today: Share of agency population reporting 6 or more months.
proposed behavior: Share of the population covered by reporting agencies, month by month, as the FBI computes it.
status: Decided 2026-10-28; the way a state's coverage is stated follows P136 and P61 (agencies that reported at least one month, with those that reported every month beside it), not month by month (cleanup 2026-11-22), audit A24, C27
test cases: coverage comparison with FBI figures, 10 states
